text: じょうれん　ばかりで　わるいね！

structure.jp: じょうれん　ばかりで

patterns.name: 〜ばかり
patterns.span: じょうれん　ばかり
patterns.explanation: ばかり after a thing means 'nothing but' that thing. じょうれん　ばかり = 'nothing but regulars'.

patterns.name: 〜で (reason)
patterns.explanation: で here is 'it is ... and so', giving the reason for the apology that follows. じょうれん　ばかりで　わるいね = 'sorry that it's all regulars'.
